bio: Potter. Wood-fired stoneware and the occasional gold seam. Kintsugi Ceramics, open since 2014.
Third-generation leatherworker. Veg-tanned, hand-stitched, built to outlive me.
Herbalist and soap-maker. Everything grows on the roof before it reaches the shelf.
Film cameras, notebooks, and other stubbornly analog objects. Shipping is slow, sorry.
Buys too many mugs. Reviews all of them.
Coffee, film, and a weakness for well-made bags.
Essays about attention, memory, and the machines we keep. Long-form, once a week, no newsletter pop-up. Formerly a librarian.
I write documentation for distributed systems and complain about it in public. Postmortems, diagrams, and the occasional benchmark.
Cooking from one small kitchen in Leipzig. Recipes tested three times, failures included. Bread, brine, and things that take all day.
Walking the long-distance paths of the Western Ghats and writing them down before I forget. Maps, mud, and bus timetables.
Digital archivist. Formats rot, checksums lie, and everyone thinks their backup works. Notes from twelve years of migrations.
Building a small furniture shop and a smaller software one. Joinery, invoices, and what a workshop teaches you about shipping.
Community organizer, part-time barista, full-time group-chat menace. If you have not heard from me today, check your other inbox.
Archivist. I read everything and reply to almost nothing. Ask me about card catalogues.
Night-shift nurse. Awake when you are not. Plant collection is out of hand and I will not be taking questions.
Furniture maker. Hand tools, slow joints, sawdust in everything I own. Commissions occasionally open.
Cartographer for a transit agency. I will absolutely correct your bus map. Weekend hiker, weekday pedant.
Product researcher. I run a poll about everything and then over-analyse the margin of error. Sample sizes are a lifestyle.
Platform engineer. Terminal, editor and build tool opinions available on request (and often without).
Cooks for a living, eats for a hobby. Noodles are a food group. I will die on the hill of putting vinegar in everything.
Dash evangelist since the Darkcoin days. Masternode operator, payments nerd, professional explainer of InstantSend at parties.
Football tactics sicko. Diagrams in the group chat, receipts in the replies. Ask me about the false nine.
Homelab goblin. 42U of regret in the garage. If it has a fan I have opinions about the noise it makes.
QA engineer. I find the edge case. Yes, that edge case. Flaky tests are a personality disorder, not a bug.
Trail runner and map hoarder. Up before the sun, home covered in mud. 50k is a fun distance, actually.
Reads more than she posts. Pays for the good stuff.
Backend contractor. If a thread saves me an afternoon it is worth a few YAPP.
Recipe tester, photo hoarder, small-tip enthusiast.
Runs a tiny dev shop. Tips instead of leaving a comment that says +1.
Film nerd. Will overpay for a good runtime take.
Lurker with a token balance.
